text: ポケモンを　たくさん　つかまえて　もちきれない　ときは　パソコン　つうしんで　あずけると　いいよ

structure.jp: ポケモンを　たくさん　つかまえて
structure.en: you catch lots of Pokémon and

structure.jp: もちきれない　ときは
structure.en: when you can't carry them all

structure.jp: パソコン　つうしんで　あずけると　いいよ
structure.en: you should store them via the PC network

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus と　いい is a friendly piece of advice: 'it's good if you do this'. あずけると　いい = 'you should store them'.

patterns.name: 〜きれない
patterns.explanation: きれない added to a verb means there is too much to do it all. もちきれない = 'can't carry them all'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.span: もちきれない　とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a phrase means 'when' that thing is the case. もちきれない　とき = 'when you can't carry them all'.
